questions.question: What is the minimum setup required to create and run a basic LlmAgent using @google/adk, including package installation, API key configuration, and a hello-world example?

What are all the environment variables supported by ADK-JS (GOOGLE_API_KEY, GOOGLE_GENAI_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY, GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT, GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION, GOOGLE_GENAI_USE_VERTEXAI, ADK_LOG_LEVEL, ADK_CAPTURE_MESSAGE_CONTENT_IN_SPANS) and what does each control?
What is the monorepo structure of adk-js, with the @google/adk core package and @google/adk-devtools dev package, and what does each workspace contain?
What are the key runtime dependencies of @google/adk (e.g., @google/genai, @modelcontextprotocol/sdk, google-auth-library, zod, lodash-es) and what role does each play?

How do you configure ADK-JS to use Vertex AI instead of the Gemini API, including the GOOGLE_GENAI_USE_VERTEXAI flag, project/location settings, and authentication via Application Default Credentials?
What are the public exports from @google/adk as defined in common.ts and index.ts, and how is the dual ESM/CJS build configured?
How does ADK-JS support browser environments via the index_web.ts entry point, and what capabilities are excluded in browser mode?
What TypeScript version and compiler settings (target ES2020, strict mode, module system) does ADK-JS require, and what are the implications for consumers?

How is the agent hierarchy structured with BaseAgent as the abstract root, and what are the concrete implementations (LlmAgent, LoopAgent, SequentialAgent, ParallelAgent) including their inheritance relationships?
How does the Symbol-based type guard pattern work in ADK-JS (e.g., BASE_AGENT_SIGNATURE_SYMBOL, isBaseAgent, isLlmAgent, isBaseTool) and why was it chosen over instanceof checks?

What is the complete request processing pipeline in LlmAgent, listing each request processor in order (BasicLlmRequestProcessor, IdentityLlmRequestProcessor, InstructionsLlmRequestProcessor, RequestConfirmationLlmRequestProcessor, ContentRequestProcessor, CodeExecutionRequestProcessor, AgentTransferLlmRequestProcessor)?
How does the InvocationContext serve as a central context object, carrying references to all services (session, artifact, memory, credential), the current agent, session, branch, and cost manager?
What is the relationship between ReadonlyContext, CallbackContext, and ToolContext in the context hierarchy, and what additional capabilities does each layer add?
How does the AsyncGenerator pattern work throughout ADK-JS, particularly in runAsync/runAsyncImpl for agents, generateContentAsync for models, and the streaming pipeline?

What design patterns are used in ADK-JS including Template Method (BaseAgent.runAsync -> runAsyncImpl), Strategy (BaseLlm, BaseSessionService), Registry/Factory (LLMRegistry), and Observer/Hook (plugins, callbacks)?
How does the delta/event-sourcing pattern work with State class maintaining value and delta, and EventActions tracking stateDelta and artifactDelta per event?

What are all the configuration options for LlmAgent (model, instruction, globalInstruction, tools, generateContentConfig, disallowTransferToParent, disallowTransferToPeers, includeContents, inputSchema, outputSchema, outputKey, callbacks, requestProcessors, responseProcessors, codeExecutor)?

How does agent transfer work via the built-in transfer_to_agent FunctionTool, including how transfer targets are determined based on parent/peer/sub-agent relationships and disallowTransferToParent/disallowTransferToPeers flags?
How does LoopAgent work, including its maxIterations configuration, escalate-based exit, and the pattern of running sub-agents sequentially within each iteration?
How does ParallelAgent implement concurrent sub-agent execution using branching (createBranchCtxForSubAgent) and the mergeAgentRuns pattern with Promise.race?
What are the agent naming rules (must be a valid identifier, cannot be 'user'), and how is name validation implemented with the isIdentifier regex and validateAgentName function?

How do beforeAgentCallback and afterAgentCallback work, including the early-exit semantics (returning Content skips agent execution), the CallbackContext provided, and support for single or array of callbacks?

How does the instruction system work, including string instructions with session state injection via {key} template syntax, InstructionProvider functions, and the distinction between instruction and globalInstruction?
How does the outputKey configuration work to store agent output in session state, including JSON parsing when outputSchema is set, and how does outputSchema enforce disallowing tools and transfers?
How does model inheritance work in agent trees, where a child LlmAgent without a model specified inherits it from its ancestor via canonicalModel traversal up the parent chain?
How does the includeContents option ('default' vs 'none') control what conversation history is sent to the model via ContentRequestProcessor?
How do you create a FunctionTool with typed parameters using Zod schemas (both v3 and v4 supported), including the ToolOptions interface, auto-naming from function name, and input validation?
How does AgentTool work to wrap an agent as a tool, including the Runner it creates internally, session/state forwarding via ForwardingArtifactService, and the skipSummarization option?

How does the MCPToolset and MCPTool integration work, including MCPConnectionParams types (StdioConnectionParams, StreamableHTTPConnectionParams, SSEConnectionParams), session management, and schema translation to Gemini format?
How does the GoogleSearchTool work as a built-in Gemini tool, and how does its processLlmRequest differ from FunctionTool by adding a Tool config directly rather than a FunctionDeclaration?

How does the ToolContext provide capabilities to tools including access to session state, artifact operations (loadArtifact, saveArtifact, listArtifacts), memory search, credential requests, and tool confirmation?
How do beforeToolCallback and afterToolCallback work for LlmAgent, including the early-exit semantics and the interaction with plugin beforeToolCallback/afterToolCallback?
How does the BaseToolset abstract class work with the ToolPredicate filter mechanism, and how does it differ from BaseTool in terms of dynamic tool discovery?
How does the long-running tool mechanism work, including the isLongRunning flag on BaseTool, longRunningToolIds on events, and the interaction with session resumption?

How does tool confirmation work via ToolContext.requestConfirmation, the ToolConfirmation class, REQUEST_CONFIRMATION_FUNCTION_CALL_NAME, and the RequestConfirmationLlmRequestProcessor that handles the confirmation round-trip?
How does the pauseOnToolCalls RunConfig option enable client-side tool execution, allowing the agent loop to suspend on any tool call?
How does the BaseLlm abstract class define the LLM contract with generateContentAsync (AsyncGenerator<LlmResponse>) and connect (for live connections), and what does maybeAppendUserContent do?

How does the Gemini class implement the BaseLlm interface, including API key vs Vertex AI mode, streaming vs non-streaming generation, thought text accumulation, and the GoogleGenAI client initialization?

How does the LLMRegistry work as a factory/registry pattern, including model name resolution via regex patterns, the LRU cache, static register method, and how Gemini and ApigeeLlm are auto-registered?
How does the ApigeeLlm extend Gemini to integrate with Apigee API gateway, and what model name patterns does it support?
What is the LlmRequest structure including contents, toolsDict, config (GenerateContentConfig), model, liveConnectConfig, and the utility functions appendInstructions and setOutputSchema?
What is the LlmResponse structure including content, partial, usageMetadata, errorCode, errorMessage, finishReason, and interrupted fields?
How do you register a custom LLM implementation by extending BaseLlm, defining supportedModels patterns, and calling LLMRegistry.register?
How does the GoogleLLMVariant (GEMINI_API vs VERTEX_AI) affect request preprocessing, including label removal for Gemini API and displayName handling?
What is the Session interface structure (id, appName, userId, state, events, lastUpdateTime) and how is a session created via BaseSessionService.createSession?
How does the State class work with its value/delta tracking, the three prefixes (app:, user:, temp:), and how temp: prefixed keys are excluded from session persistence in updateSessionState?

What methods does BaseSessionService define (createSession, getSession, getOrCreateSession, listSessions, deleteSession, appendEvent) and how does the base appendEvent implementation handle partial events and state updates?
How does InMemorySessionService implement session storage, and what are the GetSessionConfig options (numRecentEvents, afterTimestamp) for filtering events?
How does the session service registry work with getSessionServiceFromUri supporting URI schemes like 'memory://' for in-memory sessions?
How does the Runner pass stateDelta from the user's request to the session via createEventActions, and how does state accumulation work across multiple events in a session?
What is the complete Event interface structure including id, invocationId, author, actions (EventActions), content, partial, longRunningToolIds, branch, and timestamp?

What fields does the EventActions interface contain (skipSummarization, stateDelta, artifactDelta, transferToAgent, escalate, requestedAuthConfigs, requestedToolConfirmations) and what does each control?
How do the utility functions isFinalResponse, getFunctionCalls, getFunctionResponses, hasTrailingCodeExecutionResult, and stringifyContent operate on events?
How does the event branching mechanism work, where parallel sub-agents get isolated branch namespaces (e.g., 'parent.child1', 'parent.child2') so they cannot see each other's events?
How do the snake_case/camelCase event transformation utilities (transformToCamelCaseEvent, transformToSnakeCaseEvent) work, and which keys are preserved during conversion?
How does the partial event mechanism work, where partial events (event.partial = true) are yielded during streaming but not persisted to the session?
What is the AgentEvent type defined in agent_event.ts and how does it relate to the base Event interface?
How does the mergeEventActions function combine multiple EventActions objects, using dictionary merge for stateDelta/artifactDelta and last-wins for scalar fields like transferToAgent and escalate?

What is the complete Runner execution lifecycle in runAsync, from session lookup through plugin callbacks, user message appending, agent resumption determination, agent execution, event persistence, and post-run cleanup?

How does the Runner determine which agent should handle session resumption via determineAgentForResumption, including the three cases: function response matching, last-agent-with-transfer-ability, and default-to-root?
How does InMemoryRunner differ from Runner by automatically wiring InMemorySessionService, InMemoryArtifactService, and InMemoryMemoryService?
How does the RunConfig control runtime behavior including streamingMode (NONE, SSE, BIDI), maxLlmCalls (default 500), supportCfc, saveInputBlobsAsArtifacts, and pauseOnToolCalls?
How does the Runner handle artifact saving from user input via saveInputBlobsAsArtifacts, replacing inline data with file name placeholders?
How does the InvocationCostManager track and enforce LLM call limits via incrementAndEnforceLlmCallsLimit, and what happens when maxLlmCalls is exceeded?
How does SSE streaming work in the Runner when streamingMode is SSE, including how partial events are yielded but not persisted, and how the final accumulated text is flushed?
What is the complete flow of plugin callback execution in the Runner: onUserMessageCallback, beforeRunCallback, agent execution with onEventCallback on each event, and afterRunCallback?

What are all 14 lifecycle hook methods available on BasePlugin (onUserMessageCallback, beforeRunCallback, onEventCallback, afterRunCallback, beforeAgentCallback, afterAgentCallback, beforeModelCallback, afterModelCallback, onModelErrorCallback, beforeToolCallback, afterToolCallback, onToolErrorCallback) and what are their signatures?
How does the PluginManager implement the early-exit strategy where a non-undefined return from any plugin callback short-circuits all remaining plugins and agent callbacks?

How does the SecurityPlugin implement tool call policy enforcement using the BasePolicyEngine interface with ALLOW/DENY/CONFIRM outcomes, and how does the confirmation flow interact with ToolConfirmation?
What is the LoggingPlugin and how does it implement logging of agent lifecycle events?
How do plugins interact with agent callbacks in terms of execution order (plugins run before agent callbacks), and how does returning a value from a plugin prevent agent callbacks from executing?
How do you register plugins with the Runner constructor, and how does the PluginManager prevent duplicate plugin registration by name or instance?
How can plugins modify request/response content (LlmRequest, LlmResponse, tool args, tool results) in a chain where modifications propagate to subsequent plugins and callbacks?
How does the onModelErrorCallback in plugins enable recovery from model errors by providing alternative LlmResponse objects?
What are all supported AuthCredentialTypes (API_KEY, HTTP, OAUTH2, OPEN_ID_CONNECT, SERVICE_ACCOUNT) and what does each AuthCredential interface look like?

How does the OAuth2 authentication flow work in ADK-JS, including the OAuth2Auth interface fields (clientId, clientSecret, authUri, authCode, accessToken, refreshToken) and the credential exchange process?
How does ToolContext.requestCredential work to trigger credential collection, and how does getAuthResponse retrieve the auth credential from session state?
What is the AuthConfig interface with authScheme, rawAuthCredential, exchangedAuthCredential, and credentialKey, and how do these work together in the auth flow?
How does the BaseCredentialService interface work with its InMemoryCredentialService implementation for storing and retrieving credentials?
How does the credential exchanger system work with BaseCredentialExchanger and the CredentialExchangerRegistry?
How does the AuthHandler class orchestrate the authentication flow including generating auth requests and processing auth responses via session state?
How does the ServiceAccountCredential type work with Google Cloud service accounts, including the use of default credentials vs explicit key files?
What is the BaseArtifactService interface including saveArtifact (returning version number), loadArtifact (with optional version), listArtifactKeys, deleteArtifact, and listVersions?
How does artifact versioning work, where each saveArtifact call returns an incrementing version number (starting from 0), and loadArtifact can load a specific version or default to latest?

How does the GcsArtifactService implement cloud storage using @google-cloud/storage, including the file path structure (appName/userId/sessionId/filename/version) and user-scoped artifacts (user: prefix)?
How does InMemoryArtifactService implement in-memory artifact storage for testing and development?
How does the artifact service registry work with getArtifactServiceFromUri supporting URI schemes like 'gs://bucket-name' for GCS and 'memory://' for in-memory?
How do artifacts integrate with code execution, where output files from code executors are saved as artifacts via the artifactService and tracked in eventActions.artifactDelta?
How does the ForwardingArtifactService work in AgentTool to forward artifact operations from a sub-agent's runner to the parent agent's ToolContext?
What is the BaseMemoryService interface with addSessionToMemory and searchMemory methods, and what does the SearchMemoryResponse contain?
What is the MemoryEntry structure used to represent individual memory items, and how does it relate to session data?
How does InMemoryMemoryService implement session ingestion and simple text-based memory search?
How does ToolContext.searchMemory provide tools with the ability to query the memory service for relevant past interactions?
How would you implement a custom memory service (e.g., backed by a vector database) by implementing the BaseMemoryService interface?

What is the BaseCodeExecutor abstract class, including its properties (optimizeDataFile, stateful, errorRetryAttempts, codeBlockDelimiters, executionResultDelimiters) and the abstract executeCode method?
How does BuiltInCodeExecutor work as the Gemini-native code execution integration, and how does it differ from custom code executors?
How does the CodeExecutionRequestProcessor pre-process code execution, including data file optimization (CSV extraction), inline data replacement, and pre-exploration code generation?
How does the CodeExecutionResponseProcessor post-process model responses by extracting code blocks, executing them, handling errors with retry logic, and yielding execution result events?
How does the CodeExecutorContext manage code execution state including execution IDs, error counts, input files, and processed file tracking via session state?
How does stateful code execution work when BaseCodeExecutor.stateful is true, using execution IDs tied to session IDs to maintain state across code runs?
What are the CodeExecutionInput and CodeExecutionResult structures, including code, inputFiles, executionId, stdout, stderr, and outputFiles?
How does ADK-JS integrate with OpenTelemetry, including the tracer initialization ('gcp.vertex.agent'), span creation for agent invocations and LLM calls, and attribute naming conventions?
What OpenTelemetry span attributes are recorded for agent invocations (gen_ai.agent.name, gen_ai.agent.description, gen_ai.conversation.id, gen_ai.operation.name)?
What OpenTelemetry attributes are recorded for LLM calls including gen_ai.system, gen_ai.request.model, gen_ai.usage.input_tokens, gen_ai.usage.output_tokens, gen_ai.response.finish_reasons?
How does the ADK_CAPTURE_MESSAGE_CONTENT_IN_SPANS environment variable control whether request/response content is included in traces via shouldAddRequestResponseToSpans?
How does the Google Cloud telemetry integration work via getGcpExporters, including TraceExporter, MetricExporter, and GCP resource detection?
How does the runAsyncGeneratorWithOtelContext helper bind OpenTelemetry context to async generators, ensuring trace propagation across yielded values?
How does the OtelExportersConfig and OTelHooks system in setup.ts allow custom span processors and metric readers to be added?
What are all the CLI commands available in @google/adk-devtools (web, api_server, create, run, deploy cloud_run) and what does each do?

How does the 'adk web' command start the dev server with Angular debug UI, including all options (host, port, allow_origins, verbose, log_level, session_service_uri, artifact_service_uri, otel_to_cloud, compile, bundle, file_type)?
How does the 'adk create' command scaffold a new agent project, including the interactive prompts for model, API key, project, region, and language (TypeScript/JavaScript)?
How does the 'adk run' command work for CLI-based agent interaction, including session save/resume (--save_session, --resume) and replay from JSON (--replay)?
How does the 'adk deploy cloud_run' command work, including Cloud Run configuration options (project, region, service_name, temp_folder, adk_version, with_ui)?
How does the AgentLoader discover and load agents from directories, supporting both single-file agents and directory-based agents with compile and bundle options?
How does the agent file loading system support both ESM and CJS modules, and how does the compile/bundle pipeline work using esbuild for TypeScript agent files?
How does the 'adk api_server' command differ from 'adk web' by starting the server without the debug UI (serveDebugUI: false)?
What are all the REST API endpoints provided by AdkWebServer for session management (GET/POST/DELETE /apps/:appName/users/:userId/sessions[/:sessionId])?
What are the REST API endpoints for artifact management (GET/DELETE /apps/:appName/users/:userId/sessions/:sessionId/artifacts[/:artifactName][/versions[/:versionId]])?
What is the request/response format for the POST /run endpoint, including the body fields (appName, userId, sessionId, newMessage, stateDelta) and the response array of events?
How does the POST /run_sse streaming endpoint work, including SSE headers (text/event-stream), the streaming body field, and how events are formatted as 'data: JSON\n\n'?
What debug endpoints are available (GET /debug/trace/:eventId, GET /debug/trace/session/:sessionId) and what data do they return for trace inspection?
How does the GET /list-apps endpoint work to discover available agents via the AgentLoader?
How does the agent graph visualization endpoint (GET /apps/:appName/users/:userId/sessions/:sessionId/events/:eventId/graph) work, returning DOT format graph data?
What are the planned but not-yet-implemented eval set endpoints (POST eval_sets, add_session, run_eval) and what is their intended purpose?
How does the AdkWebServer handle CORS configuration via the allowOrigins option, and how does the express middleware stack work (cors, urlencoded, json)?
How does the runner caching mechanism work in AdkWebServer, where Runner instances are cached per appName to avoid re-creation?

What is the ServerOptions interface for configuring AdkWebServer including agentsDir, host, port, custom service implementations, agentLoader, serveDebugUI, allowOrigins, otelToCloud, and registerProcessors?
How does the AdkWebServer setup telemetry with internal span exporters (ApiServerSpanExporter, InMemoryExporter) and optional Google Cloud trace export?
